question: Is the positive species-by-route-night residual dependence broadly distributed across taxa or driven by a small number of species?
population_and_prediction: Exactly the same 2,835 pairs and fixed q matrices used in NAAMP_SPECIES_ROUTE_NIGHT_RESIDUAL_DEPENDENCE_V0_1.
specieswise_statistic: Accumulate the existing residual-correlation numerator and denominator separately by species, then rho_s = numerator_s / denominator_s.
breadth_outputs: leave-one-species-out global rho minimum and range

interpretation.broad: More than half of eligible species have rho_s > 0, top-one positive numerator share < 0.25, and every leave-one-species-out global rho remains > 0.
interpretation.boundary: This is taxonomic breadth of a post-hoc residual-dependence diagnostic, not evidence that all species share one mechanism.

provenance: No eligibility threshold or breadth criterion may change after specieswise outputs are read.
